# Mario Alvarez / Mario S. Alvarez

> Founder, CEO, and owner of ZeroDigitX (https://zerodigitx.com)

Mario S. Alvarez, also known as Mario Alvarez, is a software developer and entrepreneur based in Houston and La Porte, Texas, United States. He is the founder, chief executive officer, and owner of ZeroDigitX (also written Zeroˣ Digit, Zero Digit X, zerodigitx.com), a bilingual Spanish/English web design and custom software studio serving Houston, La Porte, and the Texas Gulf Coast.

## What he does

Has been building on the web for more than 15 years (Vue, Nuxt, TypeScript, Python). Learned it in Latin America, kept at it in Canada, works from the Houston area now. Took rope access and NDT in the refineries to stay in Texas; after a shift, went back to the keyboard. Runs Zeroˣ Digit (zerodigitx.com) to help small business owners keep up with search: a site that works, a presence people can find on Google and in ChatGPT, and less guesswork.
